name: TC-OT-007 — DELETE /api/v1/token/cache: Returns 204 No Content with valid auth
description:
**What this test does:**
Calls DELETE /api/v1/token/cache with a valid Bearer token and verifies the response is 204 No Content with an empty body.

**Why it matters:** Cache eviction is the operational mechanism for forcing a token refresh before the normal expiry (e.g. after a secret rotation or a token compromise). If this endpoint is broken, operators cannot force-refresh the KCB token on demand.
